summary_1line: Krishna mocks Bhima’s sudden call for peace, provoking Bhima to defend his courage and declare his immense strength while claiming compassion restrains him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna laughs and sharply rebukes Bhima as the huge warrior sits brooding apart, fists clenched and eyes blazing with restrained anger.
Bhima once swears before his brothers, raising his heavy mace and vowing to crush Duryodhana as surely as the sun rises in the east.
Bhima spreads his massive arms and boasts he could hold apart heaven and earth if they collided like two mountains.
